integration_issues.flow: Duplicate-modal auto-link → relationship label lost when picked patient is already in group
integration_issues.issue: In the family_groups.link_family_member router, `relationship` is written to `payload.other_patient_id` side. During the duplicate-flow the *new* patient is the URL-`patient_id` and the picked existing patient (already in the group) is `other_patient_id`. So `adds=[{patient_id: <new>, relationship: None}]` and the user-selected relationship (e.g. 'sibling') is silently discarded. Verified: TestFam A3E0E0 (new) was added with relationship=None despite 'sibling' being clicked. Consider: if `other_patient_id` is already a member and `patient_id` is being added, apply `payload.relationship` to the newly-added member instead.

action_items: OPTIONAL / MINOR: fix relationship-side handling in link_family_member so that when the URL patient (`patient_id`) is the one being added into an existing group, the payload.relationship gets attached to that newly-added member (currently it silently attaches only to `other_patient_id`, which may already be present → label lost). This matters primarily for the duplicate-modal auto-link path.

PRE-EXISTING (unrelated to this feature): ModernDashboard crashes with `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'split')` at initials() during render; observed as a red error page on redirect after create. Not caused by family-groups but worth flagging.
critical_code_review_comments: family_groups.py `updated_at` is stored as ISO string on updates but as a datetime on insert (via serialize_datetime). Inconsistent — will make future date-range queries brittle.
family_groups.py has no explicit clinic-scoped index; add `{clinic_id:1, group_id:1}` (unique) and `{clinic_id:1, 'members.patient_id':1}` for O(1) reverse lookups.

link_family_member: when both patients already members of the same group and no relationship supplied, the endpoint is a silent no-op — consider returning the current group anyway (currently it does — good).
The router lacks any role guard — any authenticated clinic user can link/unlink. Confirm this matches product intent (docstring says 'front-desk gets this too'). OK.

rca of the issue: Duplicate-modal auto-link relationship-loss RCA: `link_family_member` treats `payload.relationship` as the label for `payload.other_patient_id`. When the URL patient is being added into an existing group that already contains the other patient, `adds` becomes `[{patient_id: <new>, relationship: None}]` — the relationship never attaches. Fix: track which side is new; assign `payload.relationship` to that side.
